content.value: Photographs at a minimum scale of 1:6000 are to be taken for a border road design (10) map of a hilly area having elevation ranges from 160 m to 2000 m. If the focal length of the camera lens is 140 mm, what is the flying height of the aircraft above MSL? What will be the smallest scale?
